item.title: Back Bay Farmhouse in Virginia Beach could become new housing development
item.description: Plans are in the early stages to transform a popular Virginia Beach brewery into a new apartment complex on Kempsville Road, 10 On Your Side has learned.

item.title: No answers, only questions: Murder of Brian Pettinger
item.description: More than 35 years ago, 10 On Your Side first raised the question in the Brian Pettinger murder case that, whether due to proximity to the other victims and the close timing of the murders, Pettinger, who was murdered in 1987, must be considered as part of the Colonial Parkway murders.

item.title: Tree strike renders Suffolk home uninhabitable
item.description: A house on Windemere Court was deemed uninhabitable after a tree struck the roof Monday evening, according to Suffolk Fire &amp; Rescue.

item.title: ODU ROTC cadets awarded Purple Hearts, meritorious service medals
item.description: Several cadets from Old Dominion University's Army ROTC Program were honored Sunday for their actions during a deadly campus shooting on March 12, according to the U.S. Army Cadet Command.

item.title: Oceanfront holiday lights to move to Virginia Aquarium
item.description: The city of Virginia Beach plans to move its annual holiday light display from the Boardwalk to the Virginia Aquarium, shifting the event from a driving tour to a walking experience, according to information presented Tuesday in the Virginia Beach budget document.
